claim: RBI has cancelled every ₹500 note already in circulation.

best_match.primary_claim: RBI will discontinue ₹500 notes printed before 2016 from December.
best_match.true_version: RBI had announced no such deadline for ₹500 notes.

explanation: The Reserve Bank has not cancelled every ₹500 note in circulation [E1]. A newsroom repeats that there is no such order [E3]. One page does confirm that ₹500 notes are still being issued [E2].
true_version: ₹500 notes in circulation remain legal tender. RBI has not cancelled the series.
correction_message: ₹500 notes have not been cancelled. They remain legal tender.

evidence.quote: No order has been issued cancelling every ₹500 note in circulation.
evidence.passage: No order has been issued cancelling every ₹500 note in circulation.

evidence.quote: The Reserve Bank continues to issue ₹500 denomination notes.
evidence.passage: The Reserve Bank continues to issue ₹500 denomination notes.

evidence.quote: There is no RBI order withdrawing every ₹500 note from circulation.
evidence.passage: There is no RBI order withdrawing every ₹500 note from circulation.
